annotations.title: Explain This Game — why we price an NFL game there

description: Why our model prices one NFL game where it does: Kalshi price and market line, our win probability and its anchor, the model's lean in points, each team's offense/defense/special-teams rating, the QB gate, and the published position or why none. Use for "why do you price <team> vs <team> there", "explain the <team> game line".

game.description: The matchup — two teams in any form ("Bills vs Chiefs", "BUF@KC", "Buffalo at Kansas City"), or one team for its game that week.

week.description: Optional NFL week (e.g. 6). Defaults to the current week.
